note: Blessing post posted, Psalm 20:1, no redraws (blanket drawn as knit, not plaid)
caption:
A blessing for your week. Send it to someone you are praying for.

This is a prayer for anyone walking through a hard season, asking that God would hear them and keep them safe. Send it to the one who has been on your heart.

Psalm 20:1 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
